description: This file defines the QuotaManager class, which manages API call quotas, retry logic, and capacity handling for AWS SDK interactions.

classes.name: QuotaManager
classes.description: Manages API call quotas, including retry tokens, capacity management, and handling of response statuses.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the quota manager with optional configuration values such as initial tokens and costs.

methods.name: hasRetryQuota
methods.description: Determines if there is available quota for a retry based on the result.

methods.name: releaseToQuota
methods.description: Releases capacity back into the quota based on a successful or failed operation.

methods.name: getAvailableCapacity
methods.description: Returns the current available capacity for retries.
